cuts.label: ishowspeed@vod2890898173/ishowspeed-good-ishowspe-2026w41
cuts.title: Speed's chat said he looks good and he walked off
cuts.retelling: IShowSpeed gets embarrassed when chat keeps saying he looks good, snaps that they're weird little kids, then dares them to say it and blows up when someone asks if he's down bad.

cuts.label: squeex@momentgiantrockynostrilpeopleschamp-5perlkbvc7c1b3sb/squeex-escap-prison-2026w41
cuts.title: Everyone walks out on Scotty after a prisoner's advice
cuts.retelling: In a roleplay prison, Scotty gives the staff an ultimatum on a prisoner's advice, then finds out he was only meant to bluff about walking out, and the staff end up walking out on him.

cuts.label: jynxzi@vod2875798295/jynxzi-berserk-jynxzi-2026w38
cuts.title: Jynxzi opens Berserk fan mail and the first page ruins him
cuts.retelling: Jynxzi opens Berserk manga a viewer mailed him, reads the first page in a dramatic voice, then refuses to show chat the page because there is a naked man on it.

cuts.label: xqc@momentsaltybettercrocodileampenergycherry-hk5rxhmhi8_dozzo/xqc-about-invad-2026w37
cuts.title: xQc asks for attention, the in-game news puts him on the front page
cuts.hook: xQc wanted attention, the press got him
cuts.retelling: xQc tells chat to search for his crew the Brick Boys, then finds out the in-game news has him on its front page robbing an ATM, and he complains that they were harassing him.

cuts.label: alinity@vod2892098335/alinity-about-alinity-2026w41
cuts.title: Alinity's airplane bathroom disaster
cuts.hook: Alinity had to pee before landing
cuts.retelling: Alinity rushed to the plane bathroom to pee before landing, had a messy time with her hands and the napkins, and then the trash can exploded napkins everywhere when she pressed its button.

cuts.label: xqc@momentapatheticenjoyableponyrickroll-asqdbrptwall5ty5/xqc-diseas-hospital-2026w38
cuts.title: xQc's hospital has too many diseases
cuts.retelling: In a hospital roleplay where diseases are named after patients, xQc learns that the cure for everything wrong with him costs $30,000 and refuses to pay it.

cuts.label: marlon@vod2874156058/marlon-camera-facetime-2026w38
cuts.title: Marlon couldn't breathe in his fashion show outfit
cuts.hook: The fire outfit nearly choked him
cuts.retelling: Marlon thought the black outfit he was given looked fire, but a fashion artist laced him in so tight he couldn't breathe and his face swelled up.

cuts.label: ohnepixel@vod2896011569/ohnepixel-face-love-2026w41
cuts.title: Chat floods with hearts when Ohnepixel cries
cuts.retelling: A streamer gets overwhelmed reading his subreddit, chat sends red hearts, and he breaks down crying and asks for a minute.

cuts.label: forsen@momentcloudydirtygerbilstrawbeary-c9_dcjg2sstk4e2q/forsen-down-fors-2026w37
cuts.title: Forsen's drop request ends exactly how you think
cuts.retelling: Forsen begs the game to drop him at a spot, gets dropped, lands awkwardly on a building and dies, then curses the game.

cuts.label: joebartolozzi@vod2873263661/joebartolozzi-about-camp-2026w37
cuts.title: Joe Bartolozzi reacts to Chinese live-streamer training camps
cuts.hook: Joe reacts to streamer boot camps
cuts.retelling: Joe watches a video about Chinese live-streamer boot camps, wonders who would pay for them, and then laughs at the seminar chanting for gifted subs like a cult that charges thousands.

cuts.label: sodapoppin@momentbrainyminiaturenostrilklappa-efw_n11qv2xjg0oi/sodapoppin-confirm-forev-2026w37
cuts.title: Sodapoppin's reaction to Blizzard announcing Hardcore for WoW Forever at BlizzCon
cuts.retelling: At BlizzCon, Sodapoppin watches Blizzard announce Hardcore is coming to WoW Forever, and he groans in disappointment because he wanted PvP instead.

cuts.label: moistcr1tikal@momentplacidcourageouswafflebcouch-g_ksoofjpqc2owtr/moistcr1tikal-chase-design-2026w38

cuts.hook: Moist leaves the chase to text
cuts.retelling: A streamer trusts a Wolverine motorcycle chase to steer itself, steps away to text, comes back to find it still going, then claims he can't fail it and celebrates 'not pressing anything' while the footage shows a different scene, so it read
